Details 
#QLeverWD
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?obj ?objName (SAMPLE(YEAR(?birthDate)) AS ?birthYear) (SAMPLE(YEAR(?deathDate)) AS ?deathYear) (SAMPLE(?descByLabel) AS ?descByLabelSample) ?links ?depictedCount ?search ?categ ?inCategWoDepicts ?wikipedia WHERE {
  VALUES ?descBy {
  wd:Q109277663 #XVIII vol1
  wd:Q110027664 #XVIII vol2
  wd:Q110027715 #XVIII vol3
  wd:Q125555255 #XIX vol1
  wd:Q125555366 #XIX vol2
  wd:Q124510026 #XX vol1
  wd:Q124518167 #XX vol2
  wd:Q124518168 #XX vol3
  wd:Q108611244 #spbXX
  #wd:Q124821483 #prodetlit
  #wd:Q125019793 #NLR empl
}
  ?obj p:P1343 ?stmt .
  ?stmt ps:P1343 ?descBy .
  OPTIONAL { ?obj wdt:P569 ?birthDate. }
  OPTIONAL { ?obj wdt:P570 ?deathDate. }
  
  
  BIND (REPLACE(STR(?obj), ".*/", "") AS ?qid)
  # Construct the URL
  BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=haswbstatement%3AP180%3D", ?qid, "&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?search)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj wdt:P373 ?categTitle .
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:", ?categTitle)) AS ?categ)
	BIND(REPLACE(STR(?obj), ".*/", "") AS ?qid)
	BIND(ENCODE_FOR_URI(CONCAT("deepcategory:\"",?categTitle,"\" -haswbstatement:P180=",?qid)) AS ?query)
    BIND(uri(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=",?query,"&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?inCategWoDepicts) 
  }
  OPTIONAL {
  ?wikipedia schema:about ?obj . 
  ?wikipedia schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>.
  ?wikipedia schema:name ?title .
  }
  
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj rdfs:label ?objLabel .
    FILTER (LANG(?objLabel) = "ru")
  }
  BIND(COALESCE(?title,?objLabel) AS ?objName)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?descBy rdfs:label ?descByLabel .
    FILTER (LANG(?descByLabel) = "ru")
  }
  ?obj ^schema:about/wikibase:sitelinks ?links .
  OPTIONAL {
      SERVICE <https://qlever.cs.uni-freiburg.de/api/wikimedia-commons> {
        {
          SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?file) AS ?count) ?obj WHERE {
            ?file wdt:P180 ?obj .
          }
          GROUP BY ?obj
        }
      }
  }
  BIND (COALESCE(?count,0) AS ?depictedCount)
  
}
GROUP BY ?obj ?objName ?search ?depictedCount ?links ?categ ?inCategWoDepicts ?wikipedia
ORDER BY DESC(?depictedCount)
